consistency: close-to-open; explicit zero metadata/open-cache TTL for these tests
atomicity: native rename only; the complete publication chain is not one transaction
idempotency: unique run/sequence and O_EXCL; never replay an ambiguous publication

durability.metadata: PostgreSQL 19.0 with fsync, synchronous_commit and full_page_writes on
durability.objects: SeaweedFS replication 200, three simulated zone owners; full native bodies checked
durability.ack: file fsync, close, rename, directory fsync and external witness fsync complete
durability.limit: one Docker VM; no physical power-loss or permanent metadata disk-loss proof

reference_client.metadata_retry: native pinned SQL transaction retries, up to 50 with quadratic backoff; not a measured universal cancellation bound

faults.metadata: SIGKILL the sole metadata process for 15s; restart the same retained container/disk
faults.objects: SIGKILL the sole S3 gateway for 20s; retained volume/metadata services stay alive
faults.expected: blocked/error operations permitted during dependency loss; no wrong successful historical reads, no lost ACK bodies, post-recovery progress and complete reconciliation
faults.cold_probe: third distinct FUSE superblock has not read baseline data before S3 loss; premature complete read fails fault/cache qualification

compression: none; actual native object bodies must equal logical ACK payload bytes
retention: trash-days=1; expiration, delete/compaction, physical reclamation and independent restore unrun
